effective_contract_rule: all base-contract requirements remain exact except the named change_scope objects, which are replaced by this closed successor

exact_private_tuple.utf8_bytes: runtime-recomputed positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden

private_canonicalization.fresh_projection: runtime alone canonicalizes an admitted public v2 contribution into the existing private one-item tuple; public v2 bytes are never compared to private v1 bytes
private_canonicalization.resume_rule: renderer omits public v2 on resume; durable private v1 rehydrates byte-identically and existing private absence/equality/conflict rules remain exact
private_canonicalization.schema_stability: private v1 remains valid because its exact tuple shape is unchanged and hint-derived source_count now denotes one admitted aggregate record

public_fresh_hint_v2.fresh_only: optional by absence; only fresh composer/edit expansion with final templateLength > 0 emits; no-composer, programmatic, non-fresh, resume, active-stream interject, and zero-template-only paths omit
public_fresh_hint_v2.prefix_utf16_units: positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden; equals final renderer composer.templateLength in JavaScript UTF-16 code units
public_fresh_hint_v2.producer_rule: prefix_utf16_units=templateLength; utf8_bytes=TextEncoder().encode(finalMessage.slice(0, templateLength)).length; source_count=1; generic and active fresh provider-run ingresses converge at the same builder/writer
public_fresh_hint_v2.privacy: no composer object, rawText, raw prefix/content, command/template/plugin name, toolkit/id/path/URL/digest/hash, arbitrary label, or extra key
public_fresh_hint_v2.source_count_semantics: literal 1 means one privacy-preserving aggregate expanded-prefix contribution record, never a command/template/plugin count or independently proven provenance
public_fresh_hint_v2.template_rule: zero-template-only commands omit without error or coverage gap; mixed zero/nonzero expansion emits one aggregate covering the joined non-empty template prefix and zero-byte routing commands add no contribution or count
public_fresh_hint_v2.utf8_bytes: positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden; renderer claim must be independently recomputed by runtime from authoritative final message plus validated UTF-16 boundary
public_fresh_hint_v2.v1_input: unsupported at the v2 boundary; reject for composition only with fresh_hint_invalid; never heuristically upgrade or dual-parse

runtime_admission.authoritative_input: expanded authoritative final message plus the public v2 contribution
runtime_admission.boundary_rule: interpret prefix_utf16_units as JavaScript UTF-16 code units; require 0 < boundary <= authoritative message UTF-16 length; reject a boundary between a valid high/low surrogate pair
runtime_admission.failure: any schema/key/enum/type/range/size/boundary/surrogate/scalar/byte-equality violation is fresh_hint_invalid; no private mint/persist/overwrite; ordinary V4/chat/provider/tools/interactions/base RunBundle continues
runtime_admission.provenance_limit: runtime independently verifies the claimed byte total against the authoritative message prefix selected by the validated boundary; it does not independently prove the renderer assertion that the boundary originated from template expansion
runtime_admission.scalar_rule: selected prefix must be a valid Unicode scalar sequence; any unpaired high or low surrogate is invalid and is never replacement-encoded
runtime_admission.utf8_rule: strict-UTF-8 encode the authoritative prefix and require exact equality with public utf8_bytes before atomic private canonicalization
